lines.text: A hardening in part came to Israel until the Gentiles' full number comes in, so all Israel will be saved.
The Deliverer will come from Sinai and remove godlessness from Jacob, taking away their sins in God's covenant.
Regarding election, Israel is loved on account of the prophets, for God's gifts and His call are irrevocable.
The Gentiles received mercy through Israel's disobedience, and God consigned everyone to disobedience to have mercy on everyone.
God's wisdom and knowledge are deep, for from Him and through Him and to Him are all things.
